This directory contains code derived from the following project:

3DDFA-V3
https://github.com/wang-zidu/3DDFA-V3
Upstream commit: e15385837dc1e051a6cf376b3827f2e279537b29 (2024-11-10)

Copyright (c) 2024 Zidu Wang

The complete license text is available in this directory's LICENSE file.

The copied components also include code attributed upstream to:
- Deep3DFaceRecon_pytorch: https://github.com/sicxu/Deep3DFaceRecon_pytorch
  See LICENSE.Deep3DFaceRecon for its MIT license and copyright notice.
- torchvision: https://github.com/pytorch/vision
  See LICENSE.torchvision for its BSD 3-Clause license and copyright notice.

The code is used by Morphalo to reconstruct facial geometry and appearance
parameters, transfer source identity to a target face, and produce rendered
diagnostics and image-conditioning inputs.

The code has been copied and modified to:
- retain the ResNet-50 coefficient regressor from model/networks.py
- separate morphable-model decoding from the renderer and demo in model/recon.py
- retain five-point alignment and cropping from util/preprocess.py
- accept MediaPipe landmarks and externally resolved model assets
- remove unused training, recognition, detector, and rendering dependencies
- support current NumPy and Pillow APIs while preserving model conventions
- integrate inference with Morphalo's model cache and node workflow

runtime.py is Morphalo's own implementation of the inference assembly needed
by the application. It loads externally resolved local assets and coordinates
the adapted components; it was not copied verbatim from an upstream file.
Asset downloading and application-level model caching remain in Morphalo.

These modifications are not part of the original project.
See README.md for component-level provenance and integration details.

Model weights and face-model assets are not included in this directory.
They are resolved separately from the authors' Hugging Face dataset:
https://huggingface.co/datasets/Zidu-Wang/3DDFA-V3/tree/main/assets
The software licenses above do not relicense those external assets.
